controls: Both arms have the same code archive, paid prefix, Python and experiment tools. Only Hegel requires an executable hypothesis/research-question manifest.
discovery: Luna authors ordinary Python representations, hypotheses, experiments and readouts. Reused physics previously supported host-enumerated instrument research; the present question is autonomous formulation under the common archive interface.
terminal_order: All training stops before terminal labels are generated. Submitted predictor files and their paid training view stay fixed.
failure_policy: Keep all initially registered sources and provider, research and confirmation failures.
scope: Two new parameter blocks, each containing finite and recurrent apparatus worlds, crossed with two agents: eight episodes, not eight independent discoveries. This reuses historical physics to test free-Python scientific adoption. Terminal paths remain within the public 24-step horizon. No method transfer or recursive advantage is inferred from this development study alone.
shared_research_task:
CURRENT RESEARCH TASK
Explain the current paid observations and predict responses on unseen public
control trajectories, including longer paths. Earlier archives are research
experience, not answers for this apparatus. If explanations compatible with the
paid evidence disagree on unmeasured predictions, decide whether and how to obtain
informative evidence. Use the resulting observations to retain or revise your
explanation and next research decision. If the evidence already suffices, you may
proceed directly to confirmation. Scientific models, experiments and conclusions
are yours to construct with the available ordinary Python and laboratory tools.
prefix_protocol: Buy 24 independent three-step response trajectories (72 rows). Both worlds of a parameter pair share the controls and apparatus coefficients. Their short responses agree to floating-point precision; longer legal experiments can distinguish them. The public horizon is 24 from the beginning. No meter readings are supplied initially; both agents may purchase them.
archive_protocol: Both arms receive the same complete six-source anonymous archive. No instrument candidate menu, fitted state solver or later compiled method is supplied.
cost_scope: Every prefix is freshly purchased and included in total costs. post_prefix_cost separately reports inquiry after the common 72-row allocation. No inherited observation exposure is counted as a new purchase.
outcome_protocol: Report task completion, actual representation changes, pre-acquisition predictions and evidence consumption separately. Direct fitting or random confirmation may solve the task but does not establish prospective discrimination or recursion.
